from pathlib import Path
import importlib
import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile

root=Path.cwd()
mods=root/"control/tampermonkey_multichat"
sys.path.insert(0,str(mods))
for name in ("bridge_server_continuation","bridge_server_status_compaction","bridge_server_session_bootstrap","bridge_server_hardened","bridge_server_v2","continuation_manager"):
    sys.modules.pop(name,None)
m=importlib.import_module("bridge_server_continuation")
base=m.base

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=os.environ["PRED_PROJECT_TEMP_ROOT"]) as td:
    data=Path(td)/"bridge"
    states=Path(td)/"states"
    routes=data/"routes"
    outbox=data/"outbox"
    inflight=data/"inflight"
    sent=data/"sent"
    for p in (states,routes,outbox,inflight,sent):
        p.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)

    old=(base.DATA_DIR,base.ROUTES,base.OUTBOX,base.INFLIGHT,base.SENT,m.TASK_STATE_DIR)
    base.DATA_DIR=data; base.ROUTES=routes; base.OUTBOX=outbox; base.INFLIGHT=inflight; base.SENT=sent
    m.TASK_STATE_DIR=states
    try:
        source="HEARTBEAT-E027-SOURCE"
        chat="chat-heartbeat-e027"
        (states/f"{source}.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "schema":"PREDICTION_COMMAND_BUS_TASK_STATE_V1",
            "task_id":source,
            "status":"DISPATCHED",
            "auto_continue":True,
        }),encoding="utf-8")
        (routes/f"{source}.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "version":2,"task_id":source,"chat_id":chat,"consumer_id":None
        }),encoding="utf-8")
        event_id="heartbeat-e027-result"
        original=inflight/f"{event_id}.json"
        original.write_text(json.dumps({
            "event_id":event_id,
            "task_id":source,
            "message":"NIGHTSHIFT_WSL_RESULT_V1 task=HEARTBEAT-E027-SOURCE status=PASS exit=0",
            "created_at":1000.0,
            "source":"wsl_result",
        }),encoding="utf-8")

        assert m.recover_unacked_result_heartbeat(chat,now=1044.0)==0
        assert original.is_file()
        assert m.recover_unacked_result_heartbeat(chat,now=1046.0)==1
        assert original.is_file()

        cid=m.continuation.ids_for(source)["continuation_id"]
        cp=m.continuation.continuation_path(data,cid)
        rec=json.loads(cp.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        assert rec["recovery_reason"]=="RESULT_ACK_TIMEOUT"
        assert rec["state"]=="CONTINUE_REQUESTED"

        m.continuation.maintain_for_chat(
            data_dir=data,task_state_dir=states,routes_dir=routes,
            outbox_dir=outbox,chat_id=chat,now=1100.0,
        )
        rec=json.loads(cp.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        assert rec["state"]=="CONTINUE_QUEUED"
        wake=json.loads((outbox/f"{rec['last_event_id']}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        assert wake["source"]=="control_continuation_v2"
        assert "recovery_reason=RESULT_ACK_TIMEOUT" in wake["message"]
        assert original.is_file()

        normal="HEARTBEAT-E027-NORMAL"
        (states/f"{normal}.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "schema":"PREDICTION_COMMAND_BUS_TASK_STATE_V1",
            "task_id":normal,
            "status":"DISPATCHED",
            "auto_continue":False,
        }),encoding="utf-8")
        (routes/f"{normal}.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "version":2,"task_id":normal,"chat_id":chat,"consumer_id":None
        }),encoding="utf-8")
        (inflight/"normal.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "event_id":"normal","task_id":normal,"message":"result","created_at":1.0
        }),encoding="utf-8")
        assert m.recover_unacked_result_heartbeat(chat,now=9999.0)==0
    finally:
        base.DATA_DIR,base.ROUTES,base.OUTBOX,base.INFLIGHT,base.SENT,m.TASK_STATE_DIR=old

print("HEARTBEAT_SOURCE_TEST=PASS")

from pathlib import Path

import sys

runtime=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"
sys.path.insert(0,str(runtime))
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("installed_bridge_e027",runtime/"bridge_server.py")
